question: What ritual act of offering various foods into fire is attributed to the qualified practitioner?
premises: Various kinds of food are involved
The offering is made into fire
A specific agent performs this act
inference: The one who offers this various food into the fire performs the prescribed oblation.
uncertainties: The referent of etān is not explicit in this verse alone
plain_english: He who offers this food of various kinds, and these, into the fire.
